scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with finite exact-rational and deterministic numerical corroborations; no external independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real centered identity-covariance laws with exactly d+1 positive-probability atoms, d>=2. Spectral and tensor norms are for the third moment only. The Fourier weak-error interpretation uses iid increments of one fixed law. The scalar skewness optimization ingredient is known in published fixed-profile discrete literature; the assessed contribution is the full joint two-norm feasible region and its sharp extremizers. Prior-literature comparison is targeted, not exhaustive.
title: Complete spectral–Frobenius region for cubic moments of minimal-state isotropic laws
